title: 第20章 尘埃落定
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
“聂峰主，弟子有要事单独与您汇报！”

    闻言，聂无极顿住脚步，略带诧异道：“还有何话说？”

    其余人也都纷纷投去好奇目光，神色却各不相同。

    苏牧看向林语山道：“这位师姐应该是聂夫人吧，聂夫人美丽善良，多谢聂夫人方才仗义执言，苏牧铭记，弟子所禀涉及李构师兄私事，夫人也是望月峰人，不妨一起听一听，权当做个见证。”

    林语山微怔，嘴角浮现一丝浅浅的弧度，美眸眨动道：“只是就事论事，称不上什么仗义执言，苏师弟不必记挂在心。”

    她与聂无极对了下眼神，移步上前，二人一起走到铁桩近前。

    聂无极挥袖布下隔绝屏障，颔首道：“说吧。”

    苏牧抿了抿干燥的嘴唇，对视道：“聂峰主，李构师兄确为弟子所杀。”

    此话一出，聂无极直接愣住，随即挑了下眉，眯眼盯着道：“你是在戏耍本座吗？”

    “请容弟子详禀！”

    苏牧咽了咽口水，瞥了林语山一眼，组织语言细说道：“上月三十日晚，大概深夜丑时一刻左右，弟子在库房查完账，一路闲逛回寝室，途经废丹房外，忽闻院子里传来说话声……”

    “一男一女，二人在偷晴，其中男子，弟子听声音立刻分辨出属于李构。”

    “女子不知是什么人，但身份应该比李构高，被称作夫人，女子说到药引，说这批还差三个，量必须凑齐，否则上面怪罪下来担当不起，还说上个月的药引质量不行，要活的，根基越纯越好……”

    “李构当时比较色急，大概是在撕扯衣裳，边回应，说第二天便下山，实在不行掳几个外门弟子，无人会在意……”

    苏牧此番再次坦白也是被逼无奈，先前为了让白从义请动聂无极，更为辩解时增添筹码，提及了‘血魂丹’。

    根据李构的记忆，血魂丹事关重大，乃燕国修行界第一禁药，出自销声匿迹多年的魔道宗门——血煞门。

    当时在场的四人都听在耳中，不管是白从义，还是聂无极的弟子青衣女子，事后想起，都可能汇报给聂无极。

    苏牧只能硬着头皮先一步交代，不然，再被追问到自己这，必将又是一次死亡关卡。

    原本依照他的性子，即便举报提供血魂丹的线索有天大的功劳，也不会掺和进去。

    此前从李构记忆得知此事，他一点调查的心思都没动过。

    此刻，聂无极听得目光闪烁，林语山也脸色丰富多彩，倒是演技精湛。
content_en:
"Master Nie, this disciple has something important to report to you alone!"

    Hearing this, Nie Wuji paused and said with slight surprise: "What else can I say?"

    The rest of the people also cast curious glances, but their expressions were different.

    Su Mu looked at Lin Yushan and said, "This senior sister should be Mrs. Nie. Mrs. Nie is beautiful and kind. Thank you to Mrs. Nie for speaking up. Su Mu will bear in mind that the disciple's report involves Senior Brother Li Gou's private matters. My wife is also from Wangyue Peak. You might as well listen together and take it as a witness."

    Lin Yushan was slightly startled, a slight curve appeared at the corner of his mouth, and his beautiful eyes blinked: "It's just a matter of fact, it can't be called a righteous speech. Junior Brother Su doesn't need to bear it in mind."

    She made eye contact with Nie Wuji, then moved forward, and the two of them walked to the iron stake together.

    Nie Wuji waved his sleeves and put up an isolation barrier, nodded and said, "Go ahead."

    Su Mu pursed his dry lips and looked at each other and said, "Master Nie, Senior Brother Li Gou was indeed killed by his disciples."

    As soon as these words came out, Nie Wuji was stunned, and then he raised his eyebrows, squinted his eyes and said, "Are you kidding me?"

    "Please allow me, disciple, to explain in detail!"

    Su Mu swallowed his saliva, glanced at Lin Yushan, and said in detail: "On the evening of the 30th of last month, around midnight, the disciple finished checking the accounts in the warehouse and wandered back to the dormitory. Passing by the waste elixir room, he suddenly heard voices coming from the yard..."

    "A man and a woman are stealing the sun. The man among them, the disciple immediately recognized that he belonged to Li Gou by his voice."

    "I don't know who the woman is, but her status should be higher than that of Li Gou, and she is called Madam. When the woman talked about Yao Yin, she said that there are still three batches missing, and the quantity must be collected, otherwise the higher-ups will blame her for not being able to bear the burden. She also said that the quality of last month's Yao Yin was not good, and if you want to survive, the purer the foundation, the better..."

    "Li Gou was in a hurry at the time. He was probably tearing his clothes. He responded by saying that he would go down the mountain the next day. He really couldn't kidnap a few outer disciples and no one would care..."

    Su Mu was forced to confess again this time. In order to get Bai Congyi to invite Nie Wuji, he even mentioned the 'Blood Soul Pill' to add leverage to his defense.

    According to Li Gou's memory, the Blood Soul Pill is of great importance. It is the most banned drug in the spiritual world of Yan State. It comes from the Xuesha Sect, a demonic sect that has disappeared for many years.

    The four people present at the time all heard it. Whether it was Bai Congyi or Nie Wuji's disciple, the woman in green, they might report it to Nie Wuji if they thought about it afterwards.

    Su Mu could only bite the bullet and explain first, otherwise, if he was asked about it again, it would be another death level.

    Originally, according to his temperament, even if the report provided clues about the Blood Soul Pill, he would not get involved.

    Having learned about this matter from Li Gou's memory before, he had not thought about investigating at all.

    At this moment, Nie Wuji's eyes flickered when he heard this, and Lin Yushan's expression was also colorful, showing his superb acting skills.
